card.name: Start of a compound agent noun
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word or phrase that will become a person or agent noun, such as hand-washer, pres-criber or art rest-orer. It sits right after 'a good', 'the' or 'certified'.

modes.label: Opening of an agent noun
modes.description: The first piece of a longer noun naming a person or role, split across pieces.

modes.label: Start of a compound modifier
modes.description: A piece that opens a hyphenated or compound term, such as eighth-graders or Hall-of-Famer.

card.writes: It mildly promotes word-start pieces like integr, impro and implement, and suppresses unrelated odd tokens, so the effect is weak.
